the keyboard opens the context menu against the box it is in

the new controls draw from the scope's tokens in both themes

tabbing forward from the top comes back round rather than sticking
an open layer keeps the keyboard, and Escape gives it back

a caller's class replaces the component's own class of the same kind

a listbox says which option is current and Enter chooses it

something that is not there fails quickly rather than hanging

the region's pixels move with the panel, not after it

the region's spinner turns, and stops when the scope asks it to
the host page is not part of the scope's theme
